description: Detect which GTM tools a company uses from its public website. Returns CRM, sequencer, and marketing automation signals with per-tool boolean flags as a flat, Clay-ready JSON row. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_domain.description: Deprecated alias for domain, accepted by the actor for older callers. Prefer domain.

crawl_additional_pages.description: Crawl up to 2 extra pages for better coverage. Defaults to true when omitted.

domain.description: Bare company domain, e.g. stripe.com. Supply this, company_domain or url.

skipCache.description: By default a clean detection is cached for 7 days and reused. Set true to force a fresh detection.

url.description: Deprecated alias for domain, accepted by the actor as a full company website URL. Prefer domain.

name: detect_gtm_tech_stack
title: Detect GTM Tech Stack
